title: Vibe Hobby: clean call, trapped coworker in break room

lines.text: Nine one one, what's the address of your emergency?
Eighty eight sixty six Gulf Freeway, the Vibe office building by the feeder road. There's a fire on the third floor!
Okay. Where on the third floor?
The back of the building, in the truck driving school suite. Black smoke is pouring out of the windows.
My coworker Maria went back for her laptop. She's in the break room, the little kitchen at the end of the hall.
Do you know of any hazards? Gas, chemicals?
The driving school keeps oxygen tanks for their first aid class, in the back.
I'm outside, in the front parking lot.
